correctness.rationale: For each induced-component bound, direct exact face classification gives X=Y union Z, Y contractible by coning over two contractible bases and Z a cone, with Y intersection Z equal to the suspended truncated leaf simplex. Integer augmented boundary contraction identifies the surviving homology with the exterior power of the integral leaf augmentation kernel. Naturality of Mayer-Vietoris and the oriented two-center difference yields the center-swap sign, while hook-module invariants give rational quotient dimensions. Every dimension and boundary case r=2, r=t+1, r>=t+2 is explicitly handled; 45 independently enumerated small configurations verify Betti and Lefschetz characters. No finite evidence is mistaken for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The bistar is the first natural two-hub branching family beyond a star. The exact rank displays a surprising dependence only on the total leaves rather than their distribution, while the integral lattice and block-swap orientation explain a sharp quotient-homology dichotomy at equal branch sizes. These are meaningful, all-parameter topological and representation-theoretic distinctions not implied by known qualitative tree shellability or vertex-decomposition results.
